function.name: json_edit
function.description: Read or change one spot in a JSON file by JSON Pointer (e.g. /a/b/0), without text replace. get returns the value and a sha; pass that sha as expect_sha when writing so another writer's change is not lost. The file is rewritten only if the result is valid JSON.

path.description: JSON file, relative to the project directory

op.description: default get; append adds to an array; merge = JSON merge patch (null removes a key)

pointer.description: JSON Pointer; "" = whole document; "-" as last part of set = end of array

function.name: md_section
function.description: Read or change one section of a Markdown file by its heading (the section runs to the next heading of the same or higher level). list shows headings; get returns the section and a sha to pass as expect_sha when writing.

path.description: Markdown file, relative to the project directory

op.description: default get; replace sets the body (heading kept)

heading.description: heading text, e.g. "## Status" (the #s are optional)

text.description: new body, or one list item line "- ..."
